item.summary: fix(gateway): share generated session titles with worktree names and start title work at dispatch (#124787) Worktree sessions now derive their worktree/branch name from the same concise generated title the sidebar shows (bounded 8s wait, raw-prompt slug then crustacean fallback), persisted once as displayName so the chat-send pass never duplicates the model call. Dashboard title scheduling moves from the dispatch chain's finally (after the whole first turn) back to dispatch start, so long or interrupted first turns no longer leave sessions silently untitled (regression from #122471). slugifyWorktreeTitle truncates at word boundaries; dead generatedDisplayName plumbing removed.
